architecture.mechanism: Noise reduction by averaging voxels that have similar dynamic behavior after deformable image registration, which improves contrast-to-noise ratio between abnormal (ischemic) and normal myocardium.
architecture.intervention: During the manufacturer recall diagnosis of the stall/no-start, log crankshaft-position, camshaft-position and engine-speed data across repeated cranking/running cycles, align (register) successive cycles by the TDC reference signature (analogous to deformable image registration), then average only the cycle segments that show similar dynamic behavior (a 4-D similarity filter for engine signals) to suppress electrical/sensor noise and isolate the true fault signature, per the Nissan diagnostic procedure.
architecture.expected_effect: Higher signal-to-noise and contrast-to-noise in the diagnostic waveform for the fault versus normal combustion events, so the root cause (e.g., intermittent crank/cam signal dropout, misfire, or fuel/ignition fault) is correctly identified and the correct recall repair is applied, reducing misdiagnosis and repeat no-starts.
architecture.falsification_test: On a vehicle exhibiting the documented stall/no-start, record raw crank/cam/engine-speed data during at least 20 cranking events; compare fault detection and SNR/CNR of the fault signature from raw data versus cycle-aligned similarity-averaged data, using a known-good same-model reference and the Nissan procedure's pass/fail criterion; if the averaged data gives no measurable SNR/CNR improvement and no change in the identified root cause versus raw data, the mechanism is falsified.
